points: Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and in bitterness of soul she prayed unto the Lord and wept sore, while Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the Lord.

points: As she continued praying before the Lord, Eli marked her mouth. Hannah spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken, and said, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.

points: And the child Samuel ministered unto the Lord before Eli. And the word of the Lord was precious in those days; there was no open vision. So the priests were not seeing visions. He said there was no open vision.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: The child Samuel ministered unto the Lord before Eli. And the word of the Lord was precious in those days; there was no open vision. Precious means the Lord was not dealing with everybody: he was not dealing with the priests, and there were no prophets around saying, thus saith the Lord. The word was about to go only to Samuel.

note.label: 1 Samuel 3: The Lord Reveals Himself to Samuel

points: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see; and ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the Lord, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep; that the Lord called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down. And the Lord called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

A lot of you all are weak with your kids, and you will let your kids destroy your house. He restrained them not. He did not correct them. Some of you all get mad when we tell you all about your children and we tell you about your family, and you feel like we are picking on you. Here goes Eli the priest. God is complaining to a new priest, Samuel, that he is raising up: I am going to do something real bad to Eli's house, because I talked to him and he is not listening. It is the same thing in here. We will see things spiritually and tell you, your son ain't right, your daughter ain't right, your wife ain't right, and you yes us to death and overlook it like Eli, like you cannot get touched.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: The Lord called Samuel, and he answered, Here am I, and ran unto Eli; and Eli said, I called not; lie down again. The Lord called yet again, and again Samuel went to Eli. Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord, neither was the word of the Lord yet revealed unto him.

note.label: 1 Samuel 3: The Lord Reveals Himself to Samuel

points: Eli perceived: oh no, the Lord is calling him. That's that clairaudience. That's a spiritual level of a sixth sense. Read on.

I pray thee hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.

points: The ark of God was taken, and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain. Those two were wicked as hell, sleeping with the women that assembled at the door of the congregation and finessing the people's offerings, so in this battle the Most High allowed their lives to be taken, exactly as had been prophesied against the house of Eli.

note.label: 1 Samuel 4: The Ark of God Is Taken

points: Solomon thrusts out Abiathar from being priest unto the Lord, fulfilling the word the Most High spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh. The old judgment on Eli's line is carried out.
